markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the US and China agree to or announce another extension of the Busan trade truce before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Another extension means that, after Issuance, both governments announce that the Busan trade truce will continue past Jan 10, 2027. It must cover China's suspension of its additional 24% tariff on US goods and the US suspension of port fees on China-linked ships, which are now due to expire on Jan 10, 2027, or be a statement that the truce as a whole is extended. A longer-lasting trade arrangement that replaces them also qualifies.

A joint statement qualifies, as do separate official statements or notices from each government. An announcement by one government qualifies only if the other government also confirms it, and counts from the date of that confirmation. An extension announced by only one government, an extension of other measures only, and an agreement on purchases or tariff cuts that leaves those suspensions to expire do NOT qualify. Extensions announced before Issuance, including the two-month extension to Jan 10, 2027, do NOT count.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments
markets.title: Will the US and China agree to or announce another extension of the Busan trade truce before Dec 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs. It will also close early once the day after the Senate Democratic caucus elects its leader for the 120th Congress has ended.
markets.rules_primary: If Bernie Sanders publicly backs Chris Van Hollen for Senate Democratic leader when the caucus votes, or says by the end of the next day that they voted for him before Jan 3, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

"The caucus vote" refers to the Senate Democratic caucus's vote on its leader for the 120th Congress. A senator backs Chris Van Hollen by publicly stating that they support him or plan to vote for him as leader. Support conditioned only on Chris Van Hollen remaining a candidate qualifies; support subject to any other condition does not.

The market resolves to Yes if either of the following is confirmed:
Backing Chris Van Hollen is the senator's public position when the caucus votes.
By the end of the day after the vote, the senator says they voted for Chris Van Hollen, including saying "aye" on a voice vote.

A senator's own account of their vote governs over earlier statements. A senator who says they voted against Chris Van Hollen, abstained, or did not vote for him resolves to No. A senator who had not publicly backed Chris Van Hollen before the vote resolves to No if, by the end of the day after the vote, they only say they support him going forward or decline to say whether they supported him. If Chris Van Hollen is elected by acclamation without a vote, only the first route applies.

Once the day after the caucus elects its leader has ended, a senator who has met neither route above resolves to No, without waiting for Jan 3, 2027. A route met by then still counts if a Source Agency confirms it before the market settles. Each market resolves to No if Chris Van Hollen withdraws from the leadership election or the caucus does not elect its leader before Jan 3, 2027. A person who is not eligible to vote in the caucus vote as a senator or senator-elect, including a candidate whose Senate race has not been called by then, resolves to No.
markets.title: Will it be confirmed that Bernie Sanders publicly backs Chris Van Hollen for Senate Democratic leader when the caucus votes, or says by the end of the next day that they voted for him?

This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

"The caucus vote" refers to the Senate Democratic caucus's vote on its leader for the 120th Congress. A senator backs Chris Van Hollen by publicly stating that they support him or plan to vote for him as leader. Support conditioned only on Chris Van Hollen remaining a candidate qualifies; support subject to any other condition does not.

The market resolves to Yes if either of the following is confirmed:
Backing Chris Van Hollen is the senator's public position when the caucus votes.
By the end of the day after the vote, the senator says they voted for Chris Van Hollen, including saying "aye" on a voice vote.

A senator's own account of their vote governs over earlier statements. A senator who says they voted against Chris Van Hollen, abstained, or did not vote for him resolves to No. A senator who had not publicly backed Chris Van Hollen before the vote resolves to No if, by the end of the day after the vote, they only say they support him going forward or decline to say whether they supported him. If Chris Van Hollen is elected by acclamation without a vote, only the first route applies.

Once the day after the caucus elects its leader has ended, a senator who has met neither route above resolves to No, without waiting for Jan 3, 2027. A route met by then still counts if a Source Agency confirms it before the market settles. Each market resolves to No if Chris Van Hollen withdraws from the leadership election or the caucus does not elect its leader before Jan 3, 2027. A person who is not eligible to vote in the caucus vote as a senator or senator-elect, including a candidate whose Senate race has not been called by then, resolves to No.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States has in effect a Section 232 tariff of 50% on imports of wood kitchen cabinets and vanities after Issuance and before Jan 2, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A tariff is in effect when a presidential proclamation, executive order or Federal Register notice is legally in force and being applied to imports. The Section 232 duty rate on wood kitchen cabinets, vanities and their parts must be in force at 50%. A rate below 50% resolves this market NO. An effective date later than January 1, 2027 resolves this market NO, even if the instrument has issued. If the increase scheduled for January 1, 2027 is delayed, reduced or rescinded before it takes effect, or a court blocks it, this market resolves NO. Country-specific caps, exemptions or agreements, including the existing caps for the United Kingdom, the European Union and Japan, do not prevent a Yes resolution, provided the 50% rate is in force for imports not covered by such an agreement.

The following do NOT count:
An announcement, including a social media post.
An instrument that has been signed but has not taken effect.
A Section 232 tariff on other wood products, including upholstered wooden furniture, softwood timber and lumber.

markets.rules_primary: If Arizona plays in at least 5 primetime games during the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this market, a primetime game is any Pro Football regular season game officially scheduled and played in one of the following nationally designated broadcast windows: Sunday Night Football, Monday Night Football, and Thursday Night Football. Additionally, the nationally televised Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day games will also count toward a team’s total, regardless of start time. Note: The season opener scheduled for Wednesday, September 9 will not be considered a primetime game, as it does not fall within any of the designated broadcast windows listed above. 

Only games that are actually played in one of the above designated national windows will count toward a team’s total. If a team is initially scheduled for a primetime game but is later flexed out and the game is moved to a non-primetime time slot, that game will not count toward the team’s total. Conversely, a game flexed into a primetime window will count.

markets.rules_primary: If James Comer has announced that they will run for Governor of Kentucky in 2027 after Issuance and before Jan 9, 2027, including running for the nomination of any political party to contest that office, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The person must publicly announce their campaign for it to be reported by a Source Agency. Merely filing campaign paperwork with the Federal Election Commission or similar entity is insufficient without a public announcement. The announcement must be for the specific office and election year listed. Exploratory committees or statements of interest without formal campaign announcements do not qualify. Running for a party's nomination to contest the office counts as running for that office. The announcement must come from the person themselves or their official campaign, not from speculation or third-party sources.

An announcement made before Issuance does NOT resolve Yes. Announcing a campaign to contest this seat as an independent, or for any party's nomination, resolves YES. A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves YES.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
markets.rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Mt. Bachelor conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Dec 6, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Mt. Bachelor.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date. 
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If Mt. Bachelor is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Mt. Bachelor. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.rules_primary: If the total number of Central Bank of Brazil rate cuts for 2026 is exactly 4, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the number of discrete decreases in the Brazil interest rate value during calendar year 2026.

Each separate decrease counts as one rate cut, regardless of the size of the decrease. For example, a decrease from 14.75% to 14.50% counts as one rate cut, and a decrease from 14.50% to 14.25% would count as another rate cut.

Rate cuts before market issuance count, provided they occurred during calendar year 2026. As of issuance, Brazil has already had 2 qualifying 2026 rate cuts: the Selic target was reduced to 14.75% in March 2026 and to 14.50% in April 2026.

Rate hikes do not offset prior rate cuts. If the Brazil interest rate is cut, then later hiked, then later cut again, the two cuts count separately.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of Justice or the White House announces that a recipient other than Nick Shirley has received or will receive a monetary reward under the Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program (WHIP) before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program (WHIP) is the Justice Department reward program announced on Oct 20, 2026, which the Department's published terms also call the National Fraud Enforcement Division Criminal Tip Rewards Pilot Program. Subject to the exclusions below, a reward counts if the Justice Department or the White House presents or describes it as a reward for reporting fraud, whether or not the announcement names the program and whether or not the Department has published a reward determination. A statement by the President or the Vice President counts as a White House announcement. The announcement need not name the recipient, but it must identify a specific person, tip or matter, and it must be clear that the recipient is someone other than Nick Shirley, for example by identifying a different matter or more than one recipient. The reward may be of any amount, and the tip, investigation or criminal charges behind it may predate Issuance.

The following do NOT count:
An announcement of the program's rules, funding, tip portal or reward rates, without saying that a particular recipient has been or will be paid
A statement that tipsters could be or may be eligible for a reward, without saying that a particular recipient has been or will be paid
A repeat announcement, restatement or news report of a reward announced before Issuance
A reward under any other whistleblower program, such as False Claims Act relator shares, the Criminal Division's Corporate Whistleblower Awards Pilot Program or the Antitrust Division's whistleblower rewards program
Any further reward to Nick Shirley or an entity he controls

markets.rules_primary: If Waymo is operating commercial autonomous vehicle ride-hailing services available to the general public within Washington, DC before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
"Operating commercial services" means that members of the general public can download the Waymo app (or access Waymo through a partner app), request a ride with pickup and dropoff locations within Washington, DC, and receive autonomous vehicle service for a fee.

The service must be available to the general public without requiring special invitation codes, waitlist approval, or participation in testing programs, though geographic coverage within Washington, DC may be limited to certain areas. Services operating exclusively with safety drivers present do not satisfy the Payout Criterion; the service must offer fully autonomous rides (without a human safety driver) at least some of the time.

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

Waymo launches public commercial service in any part of Washington, DC
Waymo expands from adjacent areas into Washington, DC limits
Waymo operates 24/7 service or limited hours service within Washington, DC
Waymo offers service through the Uber app to all users in Washington, DC
Service is geofenced to only certain neighborhoods but is public

Examples that would resolve to No:

Waymo only operates employee shuttles or closed testing in Washington, DC
Waymo only has an office or maintenance facility in Washington, DC
All Waymo vehicles in Washington, DC have safety drivers
Waymo is testing but not offering paid public rides
Service requires being on a waitlist or having a special code
Waymo announces plans to launch but hasn't started service by Jan 1, 2027
markets.title: Will Waymo operate ride-hailing in Washington, DC before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If Venezuela agrees to or announces the completed designation, by a plenary vote of its National Assembly, of at least one new principal justice (magistrado principal) of the Supreme Tribunal of Justice before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A new principal justice is a person who is not a principal justice (magistrado principal) of the Supreme Tribunal of Justice as of Issuance. The National Assembly's plenary vote designating them qualifies; they need not have been sworn in.

The following do NOT count:

The designation of only alternate justices (magistrados suplentes)
A list of candidates from the Judicial Nominations Committee or the Citizen Power
An announcement that the vote will be held on a future date, including a scheduled plenary session
The re-designation of a sitting principal justice

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)

markets.rules_primary: If Delcy Rodríguez de facto holds the position of head of state of Venezuela at the end of 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, "Delcy Rodríguez de facto holds head of state of Venezuela" means that, at the end of 2026, Delcy Rodríguez is the individual who primarily exercises the governing authority and core powers customarily attached to head of state of Venezuela, regardless of Delcy Rodríguez's formal title, constitutional designation, formal appointment, domestic legal status, foreign recognition, or international recognition.

The Source Agency's determination of whether Delcy Rodríguez de facto holds head of state of Venezuela shall be based on objective indicators of governing authority over the functions attached to head of state of Venezuela, which may include, without limitation:

Control over the executive ministries, administrative apparatus, bureaucracy, and state institutions associated with head of state of Venezuela

markets.rules_primary: If the US agrees to or announces withdrawal from the Outer Space Treaty after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Announcements with specified future implementation dates qualify. Effective withdrawal need not occur before the deadline.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the United States and Iran hold a senior-level diplomatic meeting after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify, unless the new article itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of the publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The meeting must be deliberately convened for diplomacy or negotiation, and each country must be represented by at least one senior official who actively participates in an official capacity. It need not produce an agreement, joint statement, or commitment to further talks. Only the part of a meeting held after Issuance counts; a meeting held entirely before Issuance does not qualify, even if reported afterward.

A senior official is a head of state or government, vice president, foreign minister or other cabinet-rank minister, head of a national security council, presiding officer of a national legislature, special envoy, or anyone the head of state or government designates to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Officials whose mandate is limited to technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, or preparatory discussions do not qualify. Qualifying officials include, without limitation, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff, and Jared Kushner for the United States, and Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi, and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf for Iran.

The meeting may be direct, with the officials meeting face to face in person (interpreters permitted), or indirect, with both delegations physically present in the same facility, venue, or city for a single organized round of talks and an intermediary authorized by both governments relaying communications between them on the same calendar day in the meeting location's local time.

Phone or video contact, chance encounters, and exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities do not qualify, nor do the proceedings of standing international organizations or recurring multilateral summits such as the UN General Assembly. A separately arranged bilateral meeting held alongside such an event may qualify. A meeting does not qualify if either country is represented only by persons lacking authority to conduct diplomacy or negotiation on its behalf. The incidental presence of supporting staff does not by itself disqualify a meeting.

custom_strike.Action: Agree to or announce Argentine sovereignty recognition

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the US agrees to or announces recognition of Argentina's sovereignty over the Falkland Islands before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A definitive official announcement made before the deadline qualifies even if recognition takes effect later. A statement that only acknowledges Argentina's claim, reviews U.S. policy, supports negotiations, recognizes de facto U.K. administration, opposes the U.K. without recognizing Argentina, or concerns practical cooperation or resources does NOT qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

The ban refers to the restriction on alcohol within view of the pitch at designated football matches under the Sporting Events (Control of Alcohol etc.) Act 1985. An announced trial or pilot, or a permanent lifting at only some designated matches, qualifies. A government commitment to a trial or lifting qualifies even if its details or timing remain subject to consultation; an announcement of only a review or consultation on whether to make a change does not qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken action by personally signing an executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding adopting or directing adoption of a replacement for a preexisting official name, or restoring or directing restoration of a prior official name, for United States use after Issuance and before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying action must be of the specific type designated (executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding), be signed by the President personally during the specified time period, and explicitly address the topic in the document's operative provisions, title, or official White House summary. Actions must have legal or policy effect - ceremonial proclamations without policy impact do not qualify unless specifically included. Actions that only incidentally mention the topic, statements without formal action, actions by cabinet members, legislative proposals without executive action, and signing statements do not qualify. The action must be publicly announced or documented by a Source Agency before expiration.

A qualifying presidential action must adopt or direct adoption of a replacement for a preexisting official name, or restore or direct restoration of a prior official name, for United States use. Initially naming a previously unnamed subject does not qualify. A reversion or reinstatement of a prior name qualifies. Merely authorizing a secondary, alternate, honorary, or informal title does not qualify unless the action directs replacement of the preexisting official name. A map, database, registry, contract, or other record change by USGS, the U.S. Board on Geographic Names, the Department of the Interior, or another agency does not qualify without the President's qualifying action.

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump and Barack Obama meet (including phone calls) after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A meeting is defined as any of the following:

An in-person encounter where both parties are physically present in the same location
A virtual meeting via video conference where both parties can see and hear each other in real-time
A phone call where both parties speak directly to each other
Any combination of the above where the parties interact directly in real-time

The following qualify as meetings (though this list is not exhaustive):

Formal bilateral meetings, summits, or conferences
Informal encounters at multilateral events if documented by Source Agencies
Working dinners, lunches, or other meal meetings
Pull-aside meetings or corridor conversations if documented
Home visits or meetings at non-official locations

The following do NOT qualify as meetings:

Being present at the same event without direct interaction
Exchanging written correspondence
Communication through intermediaries without direct contact
Pre-recorded messages or asynchronous communication
Meetings cancelled after being scheduled
Near-misses where parties were scheduled to meet but did not

markets.rules_primary: If President Donald Trump gives his next qualifying address to the nation, as defined in Additional Details after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from at least four of the seven Source Agencies named in Additional Details qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify, unless the new article itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of the publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

An “address to the nation” means a prepared presidential speech that at least four of the Associated Press, Reuters, Bloomberg News, ABC, CBS, NBC, and The New York Times contemporaneously describe as an “address to the nation,” “national address,” “address to the American people,” or explicitly equivalent. At least two of ABC, CBS, and NBC must televise the speech nationwide, beginning within 60 seconds of its initial public transmission and continuing through the final prepared words. The speech may be delivered live or prerecorded. Examples include an update on Operation Epic Fury (4/1/26) and a year-end address on the economy and administration’s record (12/17/25).

The examples are illustrative only; qualification is determined solely by the definition above. A qualifying description must be published after the initial public transmission begins and must affirm that the address is underway or occurred. Advance descriptions of a planned speech do NOT qualify.

For deadline purposes, an address occurs when its initial public transmission begins. A strike can resolve Yes only if the transmission begins and all four qualifying descriptions are published before that strike date. Required network carriage may continue through the final prepared words after the strike date, but must be verified before determination.

markets.rules_primary: If the general import tariff rate on imports from People's Republic of China into the United States on Jan 1, 2027 is at least 10%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the general import tariff rate that is actually in effect (i.e., being collected) on the specified date. This includes both universal tariffs on all U.S. imports and country-specific tariffs on the specified country. Only tariffs that are currently active and being collected count - announced but not implemented tariffs, paused tariffs, or suspended tariffs do not qualify. The tariff rate refers to the general baseline rate, not including product-specific duties or exemptions. If multiple general rates apply, the general import tariff rate is the sum of all applicable general rates in effect.

Examples (for date = Jan 1, 2026):

India: 25% Reciprocal Tariff (EO 14326) + 25% Russian Oil Penalty (EO 14329) = 50%
China: 10% Reciprocal Tariff (EO 14358) + 10% Fentanyl Duty (EO 14357) = 20%
European Union: 15% Reciprocal Tariff "Floor" (EO 14326)
Falkland Islands: 10% Reciprocal Tariff (EO 14326)

custom_strike.Law: legislation that would raise Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage in steps to $15 by 2029 and index to inflation

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation that would raise Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage in steps to $15 by 2029 and index to inflation has become law in Pennsylvania before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

markets.rules_primary: If the US agrees to or announces a substantive federal action arising from its Smithsonian pressure campaign before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, a qualifying action is limited to one of the following:

A federal agency cancels, suspends, or refuses to renew an existing artifact loan to the Smithsonian.
A federal agency cancels, suspends, or refuses to renew an existing procurement-assistance arrangement with the Smithsonian.
A federal agency withholds, rescinds, suspends, or refuses a named discretionary grant to the Smithsonian, or imposes a new binding condition on that grant.
The Department of the Interior or National Park Service installs any of the temporary Smithsonian-related signs or exhibits on National Park Service property ordered by Executive Order 14416.
The President, Vice President, or another authorized executive-branch official takes a formal action that results in the removal, replacement, or resignation of the Smithsonian Secretary, or a change in voting control of the Smithsonian Board of Regents.

For the first three items, the federal action or announcement must expressly tie the decision to the dispute over Smithsonian leadership, governance, or museum content, or to Executive Order 14253, Executive Order 14416, the July 2026 White House report, or the Aug. 28, 2026 letter.

An unconditional official announcement also qualifies if the President, an authorized Cabinet official, or the responsible federal agency commits the United States to one of the listed actions, even if implementation will occur later. No other action qualifies.

A conditional threat; a review, report, recommendation, meeting request, or expression of dissatisfaction; proposed legislation; a routine Smithsonian decision; or an action completed before Issuance does NOT qualify. Executive Order 14253, Executive Order 14416 itself, the July 2026 White House report, and the Aug. 28, 2026 letter therefore do NOT qualify.

Russian-origin diesel fuel is diesel fuel produced in Russia. Diesel fuel refined in another country from Russian crude oil is not Russian-origin diesel fuel.

Diesel fuel is imported into the United States when it is physically delivered to a U.S. port, or otherwise into U.S. territory, for commercial or government use within the United States. A purchase, contract, loading or voyage of Russian-origin diesel fuel to the United States, before it is actually delivered

Diesel fuel held in bond for re-export or passing through the United States in transit to another country
An announcement, agreement or license permitting imports, before diesel fuel is actually delivered

markets.rules_primary: If Vladimir Putin visits the United States of America after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

Physical presence within the geographic boundaries is required. For countries, internationally recognized borders apply, and international airports are considered within their host jurisdiction. Evidence must be reported by at least one Source Agency and may include official announcements, news reports with specific location details, verified photographs or videos at identifiable locations, flight records showing arrival, completed official schedules, or posts from official accounts. Visits that began before market issuance do not count.

markets.rules_primary: If a federal ban on public access to open-source AI models is enacted in the United States through legislation, an executive order, a regulation or another binding federal measure before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the measure to become legally binding.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and satisfaction of any required procedural steps for implementation; a delayed effective date does not prevent enactment
Administrative regulations, including export controls: completion of required rulemaking procedures and final publication in the official government record; a binding interim final rule counts once published
Other governmental measures: official issuance in final, legally binding form

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders or proposed rules

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges. A qualifying measure counts once enacted or issued, regardless of a later effective date.

For this market, a “ban on open-source AI models” means a legally binding federal measure that prohibits distribution to, or access to or use by, the general public in the United States of at least one general-purpose large language or multimodal foundation model whose weights are publicly downloadable and usable on user-controlled hardware, such as Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek or Qwen. Source-available models qualify regardless of license restrictions on acceptable use. The measure may target one model, a named developer or country, or all such models, and may be temporary or indefinite, provided it bars ordinary public access through ordinary channels in the United States, even if copies remain available from foreign sources or prior downloads.

A measure limited to government devices, federal contractors or procurement; a measure that bars only hosted apps, websites, chatbot or API services offering the model, or removes the model from only one app store, hosting provider or other single channel, while U.S. hosts may still lawfully distribute the model's weights to the public; an export control that restricts only transfers abroad; a state or local measure; a licensing, registration or reporting requirement that does not bar public access to an existing model; or a measure covering only narrow or special-purpose, deprecated, research-only or preview-only models does NOT qualify.

markets.rules_primary:
If Kristi Noem
 has either officially announced her intention to leave the Trump administration or has actually left the Trump administration after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

To leave the Trump administration, Kristi Noem must hold no paid or unpaid Executive Branch position, including White House, senior advisor, special envoy, ambassador and Special Government Employee roles. Leaving, or announcing she will leave, one position does NOT count if she keeps another or a new position is announced at the same time. Informal advice and roles outside the Executive Branch are not positions.

markets.rules_primary: If India agrees to or announces resumption of the Indus Waters Treaty after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
India must affirmatively agree to or announce resumption of the Indus Waters Treaty. A third-party ruling or acknowledgment of the treaty's legal status alone does not qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of a previously announced commitment to resume the Treaty

An affirmative withdrawal of the abeyance decision accompanied by a renewed commitment to Treaty operation qualifies.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of people who have served as Speaker of the House during 2026 is exactly 1, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
"Served in the role" means that an individual has formally held the position in an official capacity, whether by appointment, election, succession, or acting designation, and performed the duties of that role for any length of time during the time period. If an individual serves multiple non-consecutive terms in the role, they will count once for each term (allowing an individual to be counted multiple times). If an individual holds the role temporarily in an "acting" or "interim" capacity for any amount of time, or is formally designated as such, they count as serving in the role. Dual officeholders count once per person even if holding multiple titles simultaneously.

If an individual is appointed but never sworn in, or withdraws before assuming office, they do not count as serving. Vacancies do not count as individuals serving. Posthumous designations or honorary titles do not count.

markets.rules_secondary:
"Served in the role" means that an individual has formally held the position in an official capacity, whether by appointment, election, succession, or acting designation, and performed the duties of that role for any length of time during the time period. If an individual serves multiple non-consecutive terms in the role, they will count once for each term (allowing an individual to be counted multiple times). If an individual holds the role temporarily in an "acting" or "interim" capacity for any amount of time, or is formally designated as such, they count as serving in the role. Dual officeholders count once per person even if holding multiple titles simultaneously.

If an individual is appointed but never sworn in, or withdraws before assuming office, they do not count as serving. Vacancies do not count as individuals serving. Posthumous designations or honorary titles do not count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Natalie Harp leaves (or announces she will leave) as Special Assistant and Executive Assistant to the President before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Natalie Harp holds both of these titles at the same time. She counts as having left only if she ceases to hold all White House staff positions. Moving to a different title or role inside the White House does not count.

This market resolves on a departure announced by Natalie Harp or by the White House, or on a listed source agency reporting that such an announcement has been made or confirmed. Reporting that she is expected to leave, sourced only to unnamed officials and not confirmed by Harp or the White House, does not resolve this market.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure and the natural expiration of a term.

Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions or recusals do not constitute leaving unless she formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If she vacates the role and later re-occupies it, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

If she leaves the role due to death, all contracts on her may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange.
markets.title: Will Natalie Harp announce their departure as Special Assistant and Executive Assistant to the President before Oct 1, 2026?
